title: 第1998章 风雨欲来城欲摧第1997章 帝座星的故人
lines: 第1998章风雨欲来城欲摧
几名传送阵的守卫望着李素芳等人。
他们觉得自己并没听错，从陈小可口中听到陈默表哥几个字。
要知道，陈默在仙界乃是何等人物。
他早已在仙界立足，地位更是至高无上，这样的陈默光是名头就让人觉得强大。
可是几名护卫并没听错，安可儿的确称呼陈默为表哥。
此刻的安可儿望着几名守卫，开口道：“陈默表哥，不知道这怎么了？”
此言一出，几名护卫立马望着安可儿。
不知为何，从安可儿的相貌看到了和陈默相似的模样。
他们不由惊呆了。
“这难道真的是陈默认识之人？”
说出这话，几名护卫面面相觑，神色异常诧异，然后有人拿出一副图像，这图像之上有陈默的身影，和安可儿等人对比一番更加相似了。
“看来我们没有看错，他们和陈默是有关系，咱们还是赶紧联系仙庭强者，告诉他们，我们在这里发现了陈默的亲人。”
说着，其中一名守卫便是传出传讯晶石，然后发出一道道信息。
安可儿等人等人望着这一幕，脸上更加吃惊了。
“他们看起来和陈默表哥有关系，否则也不会对陈默如此对待了。”
然而，不仅仅如此。
长空之上风起云涌，很快呈现出一道道绝世强大的身影，这些身影皆是来自各大仙庭，他们气息强大，透着恐怖的威压。
但是他们还是第一时间飞下来。
“陈默的亲人究竟在那？”
说话的乃是六道尊主，他眸子闪动，很快看到了安可儿等人。
不过，他还是耐心等待守卫的回复。
“尊主，这几人就是陈默的亲人。”
其中一名护卫开口说着，六道尊主神色一怔。
然后他跨着步子来到安可儿面前，望着和陈默有几分相似的神态。
六道尊主已经相信，这绝对就陈默的亲人。
与此同时，瑶池女皇和琴玄天等强者后面赶来，他们都是第一时间来到安可儿等人面前。
一时间，整个场面变得格外沉重。
李素芳虽然见多识广。
可是她发现，自己和这些六道尊主以及瑶池女皇等人相比还是相差太远了。
在他们身上有超凡脱俗的气质。
甚至每个守卫看着这些人都有尊敬的神色，
不用猜测，这些人肯定是大人物。
安可儿眨眨眼，望着瑶池女皇道：“你们是谁？为何来这里看我们？”
听了这话，瑶池女皇抿嘴一笑，母仪天下的姿态一览无余。
她望着安可儿，含笑道：“我是瑶池仙庭的女皇，你可以称呼我为瑶池女皇，我们来这里接你的原因也是陈默救了仙界，甚至可以说他救了我们所有人。”
“什么？”
听到瑶池女皇的一番话，安可儿不由吃惊了。
那那怕是李素芳等人也是不敢相信，陈默会出人头地，女皇和尊主等强者都被陈默所救，他们才会来这里见自己，李素芳一想到这些就万分激动。
“默儿真的长大了。”
李素芳喜极而泣，说道：“祖上有灵，默儿有出息了。”
“是啊！”
content_en:
Chapter 1998 The storm is coming and the city is about to be destroyed
Several teleportation array guards looked at Li Sufang and others.
They felt that they heard correctly and heard the words "Cousin Chen Mo" from Chen Xiaoke's mouth.
You must know what kind of person Chen Mo is in the fairy world.
He has already established himself in the fairy world, and his status is supreme. Chen Mo makes people feel powerful just by his name.
But the guards heard it right. An Keer did call Chen Mo his cousin.
At this moment, An Ke'er looked at the guards and said, "Cousin Chen Mo, I wonder what's going on?"
As soon as these words came out, several guards immediately looked at An Ke'er.
For some reason, An Keer's appearance looked similar to Chen Mo's.
They couldn't help but be stunned.
"Is this really someone Chen Mo knows?"
After saying this, several guards looked at each other with strange expressions. Then someone took out an image. There was Chen Mo's figure on the image. After comparing it with An Ke'er and others, it became even more similar.
"It seems that we are not wrong. They are related to Chen Mo. We should contact the powerful people in Xianting quickly and tell them that we found Chen Mo's relatives here."
As he said that, one of the guards passed out the communication crystal, and then sent out a message.
An Ke'er and others looked at this scene with even more surprise on their faces.
"They seem to be related to Chen Mo's cousin, otherwise they wouldn't treat Chen Mo like this."
However, it's not just that.
The sky was surging with wind and clouds, and soon a series of extremely powerful figures appeared. These figures all came from the major fairy courts. Their auras were powerful, exuding terrifying pressure.
But they still flew down immediately.
"Where are Chen Mo's relatives?"
The one who spoke was the Lord of Six Paths. His eyes flashed and he quickly saw An Keer and others.
However, he patiently waited for the guard's reply.
"Lord, these people are Chen Mo's relatives."
One of the guards spoke, and the Lord of Six Paths looked startled.
Then he strode to An Ke'er, looking at an expression somewhat similar to Chen Mo's.
The Lord of Six Paths has already believed that this is definitely Chen Mo's relative.
At the same time, Queen Yaochi, Qin Xuantian and other powerful people came from behind, and they all came to An Keer and others immediately.
For a moment, the whole scene became extremely heavy.
Although Li Sufang is well-informed.
But she found that she was still far behind the Lords of Six Paths and the Queen of Yaochi.
There is an otherworldly quality about them.
Even every guard looked at these people with a look of respect.
No need to guess, these people must be big shots.
An Keer blinked, looked at Queen Yaochi and said, "Who are you? Why are you here to see us?"
After hearing this, Queen Yaochi pursed her lips and smiled, her mother's attitude of caring for the world was clearly visible.
She looked at An Ke'er and said with a smile: "I am the Queen of Yaochi Fairyland. You can call me Queen of Yaochi. The reason why we come here to pick you up is because Chen Mo saved the fairyland. It can even be said that he saved all of us."
"What?"
Hearing what Queen Yaochi said, An Keer couldn't help but be surprised.
Even Li Sufang and others couldn't believe that Chen Mo would become famous. The Queen, the Lord and other powerful people were rescued by Chen Mo, and they would come here to see him. Li Sufang was extremely excited when she thought of this.
"Mo'er has really grown up."
Li Sufang cried with joy and said: "The ancestors have a spirit, and Mo'er has a future."
"Yes!"
